title: Cross-SDK credential orchestration and explicit iterator guard rails
author: Marisol Reyes
release_notes:
- Introduce a coordinated credential orchestration layer shared by Python/TS/Go SDKs to improve fallback determinism and reduce auth churn.
- Add explicit iterator guard rails to streaming consumers to prevent double-consumption and surface clear error messages.
- Minor telemetry for credential swaps and stream lifecycle events.
- Bump SDK versions: python 1.8.2, typescript 2.3.0, go 1.5.1.
description:
Context: Multiple customers and internal workloads exposed non-deterministic auth retries and token-fallback thundering when session handoffs coincided with streaming resumption. This PR stitches a minimal orchestration abstraction that coordinates credential providers across SDKs and adds explicit iterator guards on streaming consumers to make incorrect usage fail fast. Motivation: reduce retry storms, make cross-language behavior consistent (especially around pullstream re-entry), and give platform engineers better telemetry for credential churn.

What this PR does: - Adds a CredOrchestrator interface with a lightweight in-process registry and deterministic fallback policy. The orchestrator is pluggable; default behavior preserves previous per-SDK semantics but serializes fallback attempts for a given session id to avoid parallel refreshes. - Introduces IteratorGuard to detect multiple concurrent iterations (sync/async) and throw a descriptive error that encourages the use of resume checkpoints or the session-facade APIs. - Updates the Python, TypeScript, and Go SDK adapters to use the orchestrator where applicable and emits new telemetry events (cred.swap, cred.fallback, stream.guard_violation). - Improves backoff presets used by the SDK retry helpers to prefer jittered exponential on short-lived bursts. - Provides small version bumps and changelog entries for each SDK.

Checklist:
- [x] Design doc reviewed (ENG-1024)
- [x] Unit tests for orchestrator and iterator guard (python/ts/go)
- [x] Integration tests for session handoffs (flaky guard added; retried CI)
- [x] Telemetry events validated in staging
- [x] SDK version bumps and changelogs updated

Backward compatibility notes: The CredOrchestrator is additive and defaults to a pass-through that preserves current per-SDK behavior for apps that do not opt in. IteratorGuard is enabled by default for new streaming consumer factories; we added a flag to opt out in thin CI environments. No config surface removed.

Rollout plan: merge to main, publish SDK candidate packages to internal registries, smoke test with Dedicated canaries for 48h, then public release.

Additional context: Related Linear tasks ENG-1024 and ENG-1099 track the follow-ups for telemetry aggregation and a small server-side optimization to prefer warm credential token proxies.
commits: 1) feat(cred): add CredOrchestrator core and registry; 2) feat(stream): add IteratorGuard and guard tests; 3) refactor(py/ts/go): plug orchestrator into session managers; 4) perf: adjust retry presets and add jitter; 5) ci: add orchestrator unit matrix and update e2e jobs; 6) chore(release): bump sdk versions and changelogs
